$comment: Tracks how far Archon Arena has pulled in from keyteki (The Crucible Online). Updated by `npm run sync:upstream`; see docs/UPSTREAM.md.
note: Initial import. This repository was created from a verbatim snapshot of the upstream tree, not a git fork, so there is no shared history to merge - the sync applies a path-restricted diff instead.
$paths: Upstream-owned and kept byte-identical, so a new set's cards, tests, card data and set flags arrive on their own. server/constants.js and client/constants.js are single files, not directories - the rest of client/ is ours and is never synced.
